title: pkg/domain: apply --os-features in manifest annotate
body:
Running `podman manifest annotate --os-features` did not save the OS features. The command finished without any error, but `podman manifest inspect` showed that nothing had changed. This happened with both normal podman and `podman --remote`.

The value was being lost before it got saved. This change passes it along, both in the local code and in the remote client. I also added a test: it sets OS features with `annotate` and then checks that `manifest inspect` shows them. The test fails without this fix and passes with it.
